summary: Martial morningstar dealing 1d8 + 1 Piercing with Tenacity and Heartstopper.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 1 Piercing plus Strength modifier. Martial, one-handed, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Tenacity: When main-handed, spend a Reaction on a missed melee attack to deal Strength modifier Bludgeoning, minimum 1. This does not trigger the missed weapon action’s effect, but some equipment on-hit effects can apply.
fields.Heartstopper: Action once per Short Rest. Melee weapon attack for 1d4 Piercing plus attack ability modifier. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Chest Trauma for 2 turns. Chest Trauma removes one Action and imposes disadvantage on Constitution saves. Healing removes it.
fields.Concussive Smash: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. On a melee weapon hit, the target makes a Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2. Failure Dazes for 2 turns, removing Dexterity AC bonus, giving disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and preventing reactions that spend a Reaction point. Help ends Dazed.
fields.Dual Wielder: The source reports that a miss with a second, non-Tenacity weapon may still trigger the morningstar’s Tenacity.
fields.Enchantment: +1 to attack and damage. The damage bonus is included above.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
